about: prereg amendment 65 note 39: category vocabularies for data/probe_swap.json, frozen before any note-39 forward pass; written by a CPU agent from the answer-type labels alone, no model access (tokenizers only). Built by scripts/paper_answer_types_build.py (its docstring has the rules).

rules.forms: as written, lower case, upper initial; each with and without a leading space; the first token of each form's tokenization (add_special_tokens=False); tokens with no letter or digit and special tokens dropped
rules.scrub: type vocabulary first tokens + the item's own answer and swap answer first tokens, minus every token of every form of the item's intermediate and swap_to
rules.own: the item's own answer and swap answer first tokens, minus the excluded name tokens (arm 8)
rules.off: arm 6: len(scrub) tokens from the off chain (seeded random.Random('n39off:<tokenizer>:<item>')), first category first; never a scrub or excluded token
rules.sets: primary = closed answer type (note 39's list) and not side table; side_table = answer type equals the intermediate's type; own_pair_only = no closed vocabulary. Per tokenizer, own_answer_token_excluded items also belong to the side table (an addition to note 39, flagged).

rhyme-rain-neighbor.side_table_reason: answer type equals the intermediate's type

rhyme-spoon-orbit.side_table_reason: answer type equals the intermediate's type

season-next-winter.side_table_reason: answer type equals the intermediate's type
